name: Shootz [BETA]
desc:
THIS EXPERIENCE IS CURRENTLY IN BETA
Test your skills in this Ultimate Free For All Arena! Become the greatest assassin in the arena. Be aware of your surroundings, one wrong turn could be your last! Gather kills to upgrade your weaponry and gadgets to beat the odds stacked against you!

💻📱🎮 You can play on any device. (PC, MOBILE AND CONSOLE) 
⭐ Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates.

Premium Players get a tiny rewards boost!

Controls
R - Reload
E - Dash
C - Crouch/Slide
Q - Swap Side
F - Shield
G - Grenade
J - Carry

;joingroup (Unique Team Name)
;leavegroup
;getgroup

DISCLAIMER: Teams are created automatically when you join the team. Anybody can join the same team if they each enter the same team name!

Please contact us through the communication server if you receive any problems with purchases or other inquiries!

You can also recieve exclusive codes or important updates!

Use "2000Likes" for some cash and prisms! Next code at 4,000 likes!
